named_after.match: Match each word to the person it is named after.

rows.label: Mercator projection
rows.description: cylindrical map projection invented by Gerardus Mercator in 1569
rows.hook: flattens the globe onto a rectangle that makes Greenland look as big as Africa

rows.label: Morse code
rows.description: communication code with signals representing letters, punctuation marks and numbers
rows.hook: sends letters as short and long beeps, with three dots, three dashes, three dots meaning SOS

rows.label: Bluetooth
rows.hook: lets phones pair wirelessly with headphones and speakers, with a logo made from two ancient runes

rows.label: Ponzi scheme
rows.description: fraudulent investment scheme that pays earlier investors with proceeds from later investors
rows.hook: pays old investors with money from new ones until the whole pyramid collapses

rows.label: guillotine
rows.description: apparatus designed for carrying out executions by beheading
rows.hook: dropped a heavy angled blade to carry out executions in revolutionary France

rows.label: Caesar salad
rows.description: salad of romaine lettuce and croutons
rows.hook: mixes romaine, croutons and parmesan in a dressing, created at a Tijuana restaurant

rows.label: Mario
rows.description: fictional character in the Mario video game franchise
rows.hook: is a mustachioed plumber in red who stomps on Goombas and rescues a princess

rows.label: pilates
rows.hook: is a core-strengthening exercise method done on a mat or a machine called the reformer

rows.label: Murphy's law
rows.description: an adage or epigram that is typically stated as: "Anything that can go wrong, will go wrong".
rows.hook: is the gloomy saying that if something can go wrong, it will

rows.label: Rubik's Cube
rows.description: 3-D combination puzzle with many different permutations
rows.hook: is a six-colored twisting toy that has over 43 quintillion possible positions

rows.label: Bougainvillea
rows.hook: is a vine-like plant famous for its papery, brightly colored magenta bracts

rows.label: Beef Wellington
rows.description: filet steak with pâté and duxelles in puff pastry
rows.hook: is a fancy dish of steak and pate wrapped in golden pastry, a favorite of celebrity chefs

rows.label: Dobermann
rows.hook: is a sleek, muscular black-and-tan guard dog, bred by a German tax collector

rows.label: joule
rows.description: SI unit of energy, work and amount of heat
rows.hook: is the metric unit used to measure energy, equal to one watt for one second

rows.label: pavlova
rows.hook: is a meringue dessert topped with cream and fruit, claimed by both Australia and New Zealand

rows.label: Pyrrhic victory
rows.hook: describes a win so costly that it feels like a loss

rows.label: degree Fahrenheit
rows.hook: is the temperature scale used in the United States, where water freezes at 32 and boils at 212

rows.label: Martini
rows.description: cocktail made with gin and vermouth
rows.hook: is a drink of gin and dry vermouth garnished with an olive, shaken or stirred by James Bond

rows.label: sandwich
rows.description: food made with bread and other ingredients
rows.hook: is a lunch staple of fillings between bread slices, said to be made for a gambler at the card table

rows.label: Zeppelin
rows.hook: was a huge cigar-shaped airship, the type that burned in the Hindenburg disaster

rows.label: degree Celsius
rows.hook: is the temperature scale where water freezes at 0 and boils at 100

rows.label: Beaufort Scale
rows.description: empirical measure describing wind speed based on observed conditions
rows.hook: rates wind from calm to hurricane force from 0 to 12, long used by sailors

rows.label: kelvin
rows.hook: is the scientific temperature unit whose zero is absolute zero, the coldest possible point

rows.label: decibel
rows.description: logarithmic unit expressing the ratio of a physical quantity
rows.hook: is the unit that measures how loud a sound is

rows.label: Macadamia
rows.hook: is a tree bearing round, very hard-shelled, buttery nuts closely linked to Hawaii

rows.label: diesel engine
rows.description: internal combustion engine with quality rotational frequency governing, internal mixture formation, lean air-fuel-ratio, diffusion flame and compression ignition
rows.hook: powers trucks, trains and ships by igniting fuel with compressed hot air instead of spark plugs

rows.label: pascal
rows.description: SI unit of pressure and stress
rows.hook: is the metric unit of pressure, one newton per square meter

rows.label: saxophone
rows.hook: is the curved brass instrument with a single reed, central to jazz

rows.label: hertz
rows.hook: is the unit counting cycles per second, used for radio frequencies and sound pitch

rows.label: Dahlia
rows.hook: is a flower with layered petals, native to Mexico, and the national flower there

rows.label: watt
rows.hook: is the unit of power printed on every light bulb

rows.label: newton
rows.hook: is the unit of force, said to be about the weight of a small apple

rows.label: Wisteria
rows.hook: is a climbing vine famous for hanging clusters of fragrant purple flowers

rows.label: Earl Grey tea
rows.description: black tea blend flavored with bergamot
rows.hook: is a black tea scented with citrusy bergamot oil

rows.label: Venn diagram
rows.description: diagram that shows all possible logical relations between a collection of sets
rows.hook: uses overlapping circles to show what different groups have in common

rows.label: Bakelite
rows.hook: was the first fully synthetic plastic, used in old telephones and radios

rows.label: Magnolia
rows.hook: is a tree or shrub with large, showy blooms, among the oldest flowering plants on Earth

rows.label: teddy bear
rows.description: soft toy in the form of a bear
rows.hook: is a cuddly stuffed toy inspired by a president refusing to shoot a captured animal on a hunt

rows.label: Mohs scale of mineral hardness
rows.description: qualitative ordinal scale characterizing scratch resistance of various minerals
rows.hook: ranks minerals from 1 (talc) to 10 (diamond) by how easily they get scratched

rows.label: ampere
rows.hook: is the unit that measures the flow of electric current, often shortened to amp

rows.label: Braille script
rows.description: tactile writing system for blind and visually impaired people
rows.hook: lets blind people read using raised dots felt with the fingertips

rows.label: Rafflesia
rows.hook: is a parasitic plant that produces the largest single flower in the world, which smells like rotting meat

rows.label: Tupperware
rows.description: name of a home products line
rows.hook: is a brand of plastic food storage containers famously sold at home parties

rows.label: ohm
rows.description: SI derived unit of electrical resistance
rows.hook: is the unit of electrical resistance, written with the Greek letter omega

rows.label: pasteurization
rows.description: process in which certain foods are treated with mild heat in order to eliminate pathogens and extend shelf life
rows.hook: is the heat treatment that makes milk safe to drink by killing germs

rows.label: béchamel
rows.hook: is a creamy white sauce of butter, flour and milk, one of French cooking's mother sauces

rows.label: coulomb
rows.hook: is the unit of electric charge, equal to one ampere flowing for one second

rows.label: Richter scale
rows.hook: is the numbered system once used in the news to rate how powerful an earthquake is

rows.label: nachos
rows.hook: are tortilla chips topped with melted cheese and jalapenos, invented in a Mexican border town

rows.label: Begonia
rows.hook: is a popular houseplant with lopsided leaves and waxy pink or red flowers

rows.label: Sachertorte
rows.description: specific type of chocolate cake, or torte
rows.hook: is a rich chocolate cake with apricot jam, a signature dessert of Vienna

rows.label: graham cracker
rows.description: cracker confectionery usually sweetened with honey
rows.hook: is the sweet, crunchy honey-flavored snack used with chocolate and marshmallow in s'mores

rows.label: Ferris wheel
rows.hook: is a giant rotating observation ride first built for the Chicago world's fair

rows.label: volt
rows.description: SI unit of electric potential, of electric potential difference (voltage), and of electromotive force
rows.hook: is the unit of electrical potential, measured across the two ends of a battery or wall outlet

rows.label: Euphorbia pulcherrima
rows.hook: is the red-leafed plant traditionally displayed at Christmas
